blogs.title: Stop Paying for Every Prediction: How FeatLLM Slashes LLM Costs for Tabular Data
blogs.description: This post tackles the biggest bottleneck in using Large Language Models for spreadsheets: cost and speed. We'll explain how the new FeatLLM framework flips the script by using the LLM only once to engineer features, rather than querying it for every single row of data. Readers will learn how this approach reduces inference time to match traditional machine learning models while maintaining high accuracy, making AI viable for real-world industrial applications.

blogs.title: From Text to Truth: Teaching LLMs to Write Code That Predicts Disease and Credit Risk
blogs.description: Focuses on the unique 'feature engineering' mechanism of FeatLLM. Instead of asking an LLM to guess an answer directly, this article explores how the model acts as an expert consultant to write logical rules (e.g., 'If age > 50 AND cholesterol is high...') based on prior knowledge. We'll break down how these natural language rules are automatically parsed into executable code to create powerful new binary features that simple models can use to solve complex problems with very little data.

blogs.title: The Power of Priors: Why Your Spreadsheet Needs Common Sense More Than Big Data
blogs.description: An exploration of why FeatLLM excels in 'few-shot' learning scenarios where data is scarce. This post highlights how the framework leverages the vast general knowledge stored in LLMs (like medical facts or financial principles) to identify meaningful patterns that traditional algorithms miss. We'll discuss experimental results showing how this method filters out noise and spurious correlations better than standard baselines, offering a lifeline for industries like healthcare where labeled data is expensive and rare.
